svg.title: AWS 서비스 인프라 구성도
svg.desc: An anonymized portfolio architecture diagram showing AWS networking, development and production ECS services, logging, IAM, Secrets Manager, and CI/CD. The diagram combines Terraform configuration with required design components and does not assert live deployment status. Repeated service icons show eligible subnet placement, not running task counts. API CI/CD is a deployment design. Redis runtime installation has not been verified.

g.text: 서울 리전 · 운영/개발 서비스 · 공통 인프라
서비스 구성 · 실제 Task 수 및 AZ별 실행 수량 제외
